description.summary: apps that draw their own title bar, framed by the compositor

protocol.description:
An app that draws its own title bar - Files, its tabs in it - but not the rest of a window's frame asks here for what the compositor gives the title bars it draws itself: the outline, the shadow and the rounded corners round the window, and the layout picker under the maximise button the pointer rests on.
Any client may bind it. It changes nothing about how the window is moved, resized or maximised: that is xdg_toplevel's, as for any window that draws its own title bar.

request.name: get_window
request.description: From now on the toplevel is framed by the compositor as if its title bar were the compositor's: its corners rounded where the look has them, a shadow and an outline round it. It should have asked for client-side decorations, and draw nothing outside its geometry.

request.name: show_layouts

description.summary: the pointer rests on the maximise button

request.description: Show the layout picker under the maximise button, whose box is given in the surface's coordinates. It goes as it would from the compositor's own button: when the pointer has left both. Nothing happens where the look has no layout picker, or for a window that cannot be resized.
